## Definition of Done checklist

See the [Definition of Done](https://github.com/Teja-Pintu1998/the-art-of-sdlc/blob/main/docs/05-definition-of-ready-done.md).

- [ ] Acceptance criteria for the task verified (QA)
- [ ] CI is green (lint, types, tests, build, Lighthouse, accessibility)
- [ ] Coverage ≥ 80%, no drop from baseline
- [ ] `code-reviewer` agent: APPROVE
- [ ] `test-guardian` agent: PASS
- [ ] Feature doc in `docs/features/` updated
- [ ] Deployed to the preview environment (once task 1.7 exists)
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:` …); it becomes the squash commit on `main`
